title: Studio list-view inspector: switch between an object's list views inside the panel, so a view made with Add view can be reopened
body:
domain:ui#3 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaJoinvGQSbHeDaWBe

Filing gate: ③ triage-directed. Carded by the seat from PR #27870's report (6513772908, `out_of_scope_findings`) on #27836.
Reach: Studio › Interfaces › list-view inspector. After "Add view" (PR #27870) the panel shows the new view with "Back to …"; once the author leaves it, the view can be reopened in Studio only through a nav entry that names it.
Reader who acts: `domain:ui` (Studio).
Duplicate search: `search_issues` "studio list view switcher reopen named view inside panel" → no open card covering it (#27594 is the console runtime's list-view switcher, not Studio).

## Observed
The panel has no view switcher. An object's list views other than the one the current nav entry opens are not reachable from Studio, including a view the author just created there.

## Wanted
A view picker in the list-view inspector listing the object's views (published and draft) by label, opening the chosen one's settings. Landing: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector.tsx` (the same panel PR #27870 adds "Add view" to).

Related: #27836, PR #27870.
